source_evidence.exact_claim: For an irreducible algebraic variety over an algebraically closed field with factorial local rings, H^i(X,O_X^*) vanishes for i>=2; a locally trivial algebraic bundle with structure group GP(n-1,k) is associated to one with structure group GL(n,k).

divisor_resolution.label: divisors-lemma-locally-UFD-divisor-resolution
divisor_resolution.verified_claim: For a Noetherian integral locally UFD scheme, H^p(X,O_X^*)=0 for every p>=2.

degree_two_obstruction.label: cohomology-lemma-pointwise-envelope-degree-two-boundary
degree_two_obstruction.verified_claim: For an exact sheaf-group extension with abelian kernel, an H-torsor has a canonical degree-two obstruction in the twisted kernel, vanishing exactly when it lifts to a G-torsor.

hypotheses.finding: Noetherian integral with every local ring a UFD is exactly the hypothesis of the live vanishing lemma and is a valid strengthening of the source's irreducible locally factorial variety over an algebraically closed field. Neither algebraic closedness nor smoothness is needed for the conclusion.

zariski_exact_sequence.finding: Scalar matrices identify the central kernel with G_m. The quotient GL_n -> PGL_n is a G_m-torsor and is Zariski locally trivial, equivalently because G_m-torsors are line bundles with their zero sections removed. Thus the displayed sequence is exact as sheaves on the Zariski site.

obstruction_coefficient.finding: The live obstruction lemma normally yields H^2 in the kernel twisted by the PGL_n-torsor. Because G_m is central in GL_n, the conjugation action of PGL_n on the kernel is trivial, so this twist is canonically O_X^*. The candidate records centrality before using the untwisted group.

vanishing_and_lift.finding: The divisor-resolution lemma gives H^2(X,O_X^*)=0, so every obstruction vanishes. This proves surjectivity of the map of nonabelian H^1 pointed sets.

bundle_interpretation.finding: Zariski GL_n-torsors are frame torsors of rank-n vector bundles. Extending structure group through GL_n -> PGL_n gives the associated projective-space bundle, hence projectivization up to the standard lines-versus-quotients convention. The explicit structure-group qualification prevents any claim about non-Zariski Brauer-Severi forms.

edge_cases.finding: For n=1, PGL_1 is trivial and the statement remains valid. The proof makes no etale/fppf lifting claim and does not assert vanishing of the cohomological Brauer group in those topologies.

references.finding: Both cited live labels exist with the required statements, the Tohoku proposition locator is exact, and raw/full cross-chapter label usage is correct.

mapping_review.finding: The existing label supplies the complete higher O_X^*-cohomology vanishing, while the new label supplies the exact PGL_n-to-GL_n lifting and projective-bundle consequence. Their hypotheses strictly include the source setting, so the two-label mapping is substantively equivalent rather than weaker. No source repair or issue append is needed.
